items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: "we did the first one with Red Allen with the Mills Blue Rhythm Band."

ctx.x: Oh, "Little John Special" -- that was a big hit, wasn't it?
Yeah, that was a biggie. "Rock Around the Clock," "Don't Cry Baby," "Ride Red Ride," the second version-- we did the first one with Red Allen with the Mills Blue Rhythm Band.
